learning_outcomes.text: The student constructs for him/herself an idea of the most important abstractions, principles, definitions and concepts of classical mechanics and thermophysics.
The student develops the ability to apply classical mechanics and thermophysics in simple calculations.
Students form mental structures and mathematical skills, with which s/he is able to translate the principles and definitions of physics into mathematical expressions.

syllabus_topics: Mathematics: applications of vector and differential calculus, differentiation and integration, trigonometry on physics
Kinematics: translational and rotational motion, relative motion and Galilean coordinate transformations
Dynamics: Newton's laws of motion, particles and rigid body dynamics; momentum
Energy considerations: work, power and energy; potential energy and conservation laws
Oscillatory and wave motion: harmonic oscillator, undamped, damped, and forced oscillation; mechanical waves
Basics of thermodynamics: temperature, heat, thermodynamical processes, thermal phenomena
